title: gcc vars
description: Configuration variables for the GNU Compiler Collection (GCC) component

GCC_VERSION.description: Version of GCC to install or build.

GCC_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for GCC ('system' via OS/selected package manager, 'from-source' compiled from source, 'libscript_native' prebuilt archive, or version managers).

GCC_PKG_MGR.description: Specific package manager to use when installing GCC (e.g., apt-get, apk, dnf, brew, pacman, winget, choco, scoop, nix, spack).

GCC_BUILD_TOOLCHAIN.description: Bootstrap C toolchain used when GCC_INSTALL_METHOD='from-source'.

GCC_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Optional explicit download URL for GCC source or prebuilt archive.

GCC_CFLAGS.description: Default compiler flags exported by the GCC environment.
